notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.content:
Added the option to open the main-menu with tab.
Added a new lewd scene for when climbing floors in survival modes.

notes.title: Short Stax Patch 1.12
notes.content:
Added a background icon to the cards to see what class they belong to. (only relevant for some achievements)
Changed the game-over art.

notes.title: Patch 1.11
notes.content: Some small bugfixes, bonus cards, and balance changes.

notes.title: Short Stax 1.10
notes.content:
Tiny update with some small requested features.
You can now continue from the post-battle scene by pressing the space key.
I've added a restart button to the main-menu, for if someone wants to restart without quitting. 
Short Stax was originally made for a game jam so some of the art was a bit rushed. I've replaced those images for a more cohesive style. 
Some minuscule balance changes has been made to various cards and the rate of earning cash. 

Please get in touch if you have any other suggestions :3
Thank you for playing <3
